title: Billy Goodall and Lester's treatment in Georgia
summary: Jones recalls a bass player guarding Lester at gunpoint to make him play, and Lester's transfer to Camp Stewart.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: You know Billy Goodall that was playing bass with Joe Bushkin before you got there. He has 9 children. He's right out of Baltimore and Washington right now.

He had to pull a gun on Lester Young and come over to the colored section and poke a gun in his ribs and go over and have Lester Young to play his horn while he plays bass all day long, and then take a gun and poke it in his ribs and take him back over to the black sector.
In Georgia. After they got a hold of him and found out what he was doing, they sent him up to Camp Stewart. Then a trumpet player became an MP and he had to walk in and say, 'Come on, nigger.'
